title: Bounded constructible affine projection duality
statement: Fix a universe u, a prime ell and a field k of positive characteristic different from ell. All schemes are separated finite-type k-schemes in u. Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring with a certificate IsEllAdicCoefficient ell Lambda, allowing continuous finite extensions, integral valuation rings with torsion, and the finite-subextension-valued algebraic closure [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate]. Write B_T for the full bounded constructible subcategory of the ordinary unbounded derived category of internal Lambda_T-module objects [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible; sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Let Y be such a scheme, n a finite type in u, A=A^n_Y, and p:A -> Y the projection. Let c_p be the recorded compactificationOverField p. For every K in B_Y there is P in B_A and equivalences e_M:Hom(Rp!_{c_p} M,K) ~= Hom(M,P) for every M in B_A, satisfying e_M(Rp!_{c_p}(a);b)=a;e_N(b) for every a:M -> N and b:Rp!_{c_p} N -> K. The scheme A is finite type, quasi-compact and separated, as recorded by the explicit local instances in the Lean statement.

proof.text: Use closed-support representability, bounded/ambient compatibility and exactness of closed pushforward to show the bounded closed pushforward is left adjoint. Proper compactification comparison transfers this to compact support along closed immersions, including all isomorphisms and the empty-coordinate affine projection.

A finite coordinate reindexing is a scheme isomorphism over the base. For a sum n+m, the affine-space sum isomorphism identifies the projection with an isomorphism followed by the projection A^m_(A^n_Y) -> A^n_Y and then A^n_Y -> Y. Compact-support composition and composition of left adjoints transfer these adjunctions to the sum projection.

Apply Finite.induction_empty_option uniformly over every standing base. The empty case is the closed isomorphism already handled; the option case is the sum with a one-element coordinate set and the affine-line adjunction on the new base. This proves the bounded compact-support projection is left adjoint for every finite coordinate type.

Take its right adjoint applied to K. It belongs to the bounded constructible full subcategory by construction. The compact-support bounded/ambient compatibility and the fully faithful inclusions transport its adjunction Hom equivalences to the ambient Hom sets. The compatibility naturality square and left naturality of the adjunction give the asserted source-naturality equation. All representatives and adjoints are chosen only locally in theorem proofs and are determined up to the isomorphism used downstream.

theorem affine_projection_representable (n : Type u) [Finite n]
    (K : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ Y.left)).FullSubcategory) :
    let A : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk ((𝔸(n; Y.left) ↘ Y.left) ≫ Y.hom)
    let p : A ⟶ Y := Over.homMk (𝔸(n; Y.left) ↘ Y.left) rfl
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType A.hom :=
      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType ((𝔸(n; Y.left) ↘ Y.left) ≫ Y.hom))
    letI : QuasiCompact A.hom :=
      inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact ((𝔸(n; Y.left) ↘ Y.left) ≫ Y.hom))
    letI : IsSeparated A.hom :=
      inferInstanceAs (IsSeparated ((𝔸(n; Y.left) ↘ Y.left) ≫ Y.hom))
    ∃ P : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ A.left)).FullSubcategory,
      ∃ e : ∀ M : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ A.left)).FullSubcategory,
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ (compactificationOverField p)).obj
          M.obj ⟶ K.obj) ≃ (M.obj ⟶ P.obj),
        ∀ (M N : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ A.left)).FullSubcategory)
          (a : M.obj ⟶ N.obj)
          (b : (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ
            (compactificationOverField p)).obj N.obj ⟶ K.obj),
          e M ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ
            (compactificationOverField p)).map a ≫ b) = a ≫ e N b
